To prevent diff churn and ensure deterministic ordering, the required rule IDs should be sorted alphabetically. This aligns with the repository's general rules for strict byte-order sorting of generated JSON arrays.

```suggestion
const REQUIRED_RULE_IDS = [
  'accepted_fact_requires_provenance',
  'mastery_overclaim_blocked',
  'method_confidence_overclaim_blocked',
  'prerequisite_direction_misuse_blocked',
  'provisional_safe_requires_tentative_wording',
  'rights_display_override_blocked',
  'unsafe_statuses_blocked_from_answer_facts',
  'unsupported_misconception_blocked',
];
```

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Avoid using the default `.sort()` without a comparison function, as it can introduce locale-sensitive discrepancies across different runtime environments. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.

```suggestion
function sortedUnique(values) {
  return [...new Set((Array.isArray(values) ? values : [])
    .filter((value) => value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== '')
    .map(String))]
    .sort((a, b) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
}
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Avoid using Intl.Collator with an undefined locale for sorting. Instead, use a strict lexicographical byte-order comparison to ensure locale-independent, deterministic ordering.
</details>

When dereferencing and mapping properties from potentially missing or malformed input artifacts, use Array.isArray to safely default to an empty array if the property is not an array, preventing TypeErrors.

```suggestion
function renderReadback(result) {
  const { fixtures, validatorResult } = result;
  const fixtureResults = Array.isArray(fixtures?.fixture_results) ? fixtures.fixture_results : [];
  const fixtureRows = fixtureResults.map((fixtureItem) => [
    fixtureItem?.fixture_id,
    fixtureItem?.actual_validation_status,
    Array.isArray(fixtureItem?.errors) && fixtureItem.errors.length > 0 ? fixtureItem.errors.join(',') : 'none',
    fixtureItem?.pass ? 'pass' : 'fail',
  ]);
```

